action.rotp_bnrwk.bnrwk_plant_bomb.desc: Touch an entity, item, block or fluid to plant a clock pin. A few seconds later the pin springs up and explodes. Up to 8 pins can be planted at once.
action.rotp_bnrwk.bnrwk_bomb_throw.desc: Throw several clock pins in a spread. They stick to whatever they hit and explode after a short delay.
action.rotp_bnrwk.bnrwk_smoke_bomb.desc: Create a cloud of smoke filled with many tiny clock pins that go off one after another.
death.attack.bnrwk_bomb: %1$s was blown up by a clock pin
death.attack.bnrwk_bomb.player: %1$s was blown up by %2$s's clock pin
action.rotp_bnrwk.bnrwk_item_bomb.desc: Turns one item from your hand into a bomb and tosses it. The item explodes together with the clock pin.
action.rotp_bnrwk.bnrwk_entity_bomb.desc: Plant a clock pin on the mob, player or item you are looking at, up to 3.5 blocks away. Walls block the aim.
tooltip.rotp_bnrwk.armed_item: Armed with a clock pin - the fuse is ticking
tooltip.rotp_bnrwk.armed_item.hint: Hold it in your hand with the right mouse button pressed to delay the explosion
